title: pedicularis omiiana subsp. diffusa
intro: Pedicularis omiiana subsp. diffusa, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the balsam family, is a type of lousewort. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pedicularis omiiana subsp. diffusa include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
